question: 7 men or 6 women can do a job in 15 days. 7 men work for 8 days and leave. The number of women required to complete the remaining work in 6 days is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

7 men or 6 women complete the work in 15 days, so 7 men = 6 women.

Therefore, 7 men working for 8 days is exactly equivalent to 6 women working for 8 days.

Total work = 6 women × 15 days = 90 woman-days.

Work done in 8 days = 6 women × 8 days = 48 woman-days.

Remaining work = 90 − 48 = 42 woman-days.

Number of women needed to complete 42 woman-days in 6 days = 42 ÷ 6 = 7.

**∴ The correct answer is 7 women.**
